title: Pre-Orders & Back-Orders: Cancellation Cutoffs and Refund Terms by Type
content:
These terms set out, for each Pre-Orders & Back-Orders reservation type, the last point at which the customer may cancel at will, how deposit refunds are flagged around that point, whether the supplier can cancel the item, and where and how fast refunds are paid.

| | Standard Back-Order | Supplier Direct Back-Order | Seasonal Pre-Order | Launch Pre-Order | Deposit Pre-Order | Made-to-Order Reservation |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Customer may cancel at will | Before allocation | Before allocation | Before allocation | Before allocation | Before allocation | Before production starts |
| Deposit refundable on a cancellation before the cutoff (flag) | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Deposit kept on a customer cancellation after the cutoff (flag) | No | No | No | No | No | Yes |
| Every cancellation caused by Marlowe & Finch or its supplier refunds the deposit in full | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Supplier can cancel the item outright | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | No |
| Refunds paid to | Original tender | Original tender | Original tender | Original tender | Original tender | Original tender |
| Refund owed on cancellation issued within (business days) | 7 | 7 | 7 | 7 | 7 | 7 |

**Terms**

1. The cutoff is a status point in the reservation's life. For five types it is allocation, when a unit is set aside for the reservation. For the Made-to-Order Reservation it is the start of production.
2. Refunds owed on cancellation go back to the original tender within 7 business days, whatever the type.
3. A Deposit Pre-Order or a Made-to-Order Reservation cannot be cancelled by the supplier. The four other types can be.

**Comparison by type**

| Type | Cutoff for cancelling at will | Supplier can cancel |
|---|---|---|
| Standard Back-Order, Supplier Direct Back-Order, Seasonal Pre-Order, Launch Pre-Order | Before allocation | Yes |
| Deposit Pre-Order | Before allocation | No |
| Made-to-Order Reservation | Before production starts | No |
